subject: german

rounds.lie: “Wir schmücken den Weihnachtsbaum” means “We chop down the Christmas tree”.
rounds.why: Wrong: “schmücken” means “to decorate”. To chop/fell a tree would be “fällen”.
rounds.truth: “Wir schmücken den Weihnachtsbaum” means “We decorate the Christmas tree”.

rounds.lie: “Ich ernähre mich ausgewogen” means “I feed myself unevenly”.
rounds.why: Wrong: “ausgewogen” means “balanced”, so this means a balanced diet, not an uneven one.
rounds.truth: “Ich ernähre mich ausgewogen” means “I eat a balanced diet”.

rounds.why: “Das Rauchen” means “smoking”. A room is “der Raum / das Zimmer”.
truths: “Man muss fettiges Essen vermeiden” means “You must avoid fatty food”.

rounds.lie: “Gestern bin ich zu einem Konzert gegangen” means “Tomorrow I will go to a concert”.
rounds.why: “Bin... gegangen” is the perfect tense = “I went”. “Tomorrow I will go” is “Morgen gehe ich / werde ich gehen”.
rounds.truth: “Gestern bin ich zu einem Konzert gegangen” means “Yesterday I went to a concert”.
truths: “Das Oktoberfest” is a folk festival in Munich.
“Ich folge vielen Influencern” means “I follow many influencers”.

rounds.lie: “Ich bekomme ein Geschenk” means “I am becoming a present”.
rounds.why: False friend — “bekommen” means “to get/receive”. “To become” is “werden”.
rounds.truth: “Ich bekomme ein Geschenk” means “I am getting a present”.
truths: “Ich verstehe mich gut mit meiner Schwester” means “I get on well with my sister”.
“Ich bin Einzelkind” means “I am an only child”.

rounds.lie: “Wir feiern Karneval im Februar” means “We avoid carnival in February”.
rounds.truth: “Wir feiern Karneval im Februar” means “We celebrate carnival in February”.
